reason: B is more coherent and testable because it identifies a specific starting alloy, temperature, processing route, baseline, measurements, and falsification criteria, whereas A proposes replacing Ti or Zr in example baselines that contain neither and asserts an unsupported ~10% threshold over an excessively broad temperature range. B remains imperfect because Mo addition and homogenization are confounded and the proposed shift toward edge-dislocation-mediated plasticity is not firmly established, but the combined intervention can still be tested against its stated baseline.
